newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-JP Morgan starts Argentaria.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-JP Morgan starts Argentaria.

text.p: JP Morgan initiated coverage of Spanish bank Argentaria with a "market performer" rating, setting a year-end price target of 9,400 pesetas, the investment bank said on Friday.

Shares in Argentaria, which were off 100 pesetas to 8,480 at 1016 GMT, were trading at an estimated 12 percent discount to the sector average, based on estimates for reported price-per-earnings in 1997, JP Morgan said.
It said a 10 percent discount was justified by the stock's "below average EPS growth prospects...and by Argentaria's strategic uncertainties."

"We believe that any further upside in Argentaria's share price will depend on successful development of the retail banking business, visible signs that cost restructuring is bearing fruit and success in offsetting the impact of prepayments and re-negotiations in the institutional lending and mortgage business," JP Morgan said.

New management is attempting to re-engineer Spain's fourth largest bank through cost-cutting, tackling margin pressure at institutional and mortgage banking, and through expansion of its retail banking presence, it said.
